name: Tom
nameVi: Tôm sú, tôm sắt, tôm đất
summary: Most of the prawns here are tôm sú, from the sea or from ponds. Tôm đất has a soft clear shell and chewy sweet meat, and tôm sắt has a hard shell.
origin: Can Gio. Sài Gòn Giải Phóng, 17 Feb 2014, on tôm sú, tôm sắt, tôm đất, and tôm gạch son.
seoTitle: Tom — shrimp from the Can Gio coast
seoDescription: Can Gio prawns are mostly tôm sú. Tôm đất has a soft clear shell and chewy sweet meat.
texture: The story calls tôm đất chewy.
howToEat: When to order it is Check on arrival, except the lunar months 3 and 4 line for tôm gạch son.
